groups.source_quote: COMP | COMP 2000-level or above Electives [Any 6 courses of the subject and level as specified. For students who have taken the 6-credit course COMP 4981 or COMP 4981H to fulfill this elective requirement, the minimum number of courses required to satisfy this requirement may be reduced by one.
